newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Copps to extend funding for CBC.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Copps to extend funding for CBC.

text.p: Canadian Heritage Minister Sheila Copps said on Tuesday the federal government would guarantee funding for the state-run Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (CBC) for five years and provide additional funding for CBC Radio.

The government, which has been criticized for not meeting its campaign promise to guarantee stable long-term funding for the CBC, said that C$10 million in additional funding would be available on April 1, to fund CBC Radio programming in French and English.
Copps also said the government would guarantee stable funding for the CBC for five years starting April 1, 1998.

"We are actually puting an item in the fiscal framework of the government to have a five year CBC stable fund. It's not simply a promise - it is a substantive commitment," Copps told reporters after a cabinet meeting.
